text:
tori h: kicking off a small rollout of ff `adaptive-cache-route` today. plan: 0% -> 1% -> 8% -> 25% with checks. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/KB/adaptive-cache-route
ben s: ack. window 03:00-05:00 UTC. main gates: p95 latency, errors, and cache hit-rate. rollback: p95 +20% for 5m or errors >1.4x baseline.
deploy-bot: deploy job 5001 queued (image rwd/adapt-cache:v20260323). dry-run OK.
tori h: can we pin fallback routing so we can revert quickly? yasmin p: pinned routing.fallback -> v1-fallback using `rwdctl config set routing.fallback v1 --pin`
deploy-bot: feature flag adaptive-cache-route -> 1% applied. cohorts live.
ben s: initial sensors look fine. small p99 jitter but p95 steady. starting eval run for short- and long-context slices.
sre-oncall: standing by. set an autopause at p95 delta 25% for 3m.
release-bot: draft note added; will include rollback steps and pinned config info.
ben s: holding at 1% for 12m. no regressions seen. proceeding to 8%.
deploy-bot: adaptive-cache-route -> 8% applied. cohorts updated.
ben s: after ramp, noticing increased KV-cache churn and a pod with GC spikes (router-5).
yasmin p: logs show high cache eviction rate on router-5. reducing cache size in patched image rwd/adapt-cache:v20260323b. planning canary swap.
tori h: do canary swap, keep flag at 8%. do not rollback yet.
deploy-bot: canary: replacing router-5 with patched image v20260323b.
ben s: patched pod stable. cache evictions down 70%. p95 back to baseline. recommend moving to 25%.
tori h: ramping to 25% now. ops, SRE watch autopause rules closely.
deploy-bot: feature flag adaptive-cache-route -> 25% applied. cohorts updated.
ben s: at 25% we see long-context p95 +22% and a small quality delta on eval long-context (0.9%). autopause triggered and rollout paused at 25%.
sre-oncall: autopause engaged. leaving flag at 25%.
yasmin p: preparing targeted cohort drain to reduce long-context weight on cohorts >10%: `rwdctl ff tweak adaptive-cache-route --cohort-threshold 10 --long-context-weight 0.6`
deploy-bot: cohort tweak applied. long-context traffic for large cohorts reduced by 40%.
nori h: re-run long-context evals and telemetry monitors.
ben s: metrics improving but still close to threshold. holding paused overnight for deeper analysis. created ticket #5621 and tagged product.
release-bot: rollout status updated: PAUSED @25% - reason: long-context latency/quality. link: https://release.redwood/status/5001
yasmin p: rollback playbook ready: `rwdctl ff set adaptive-cache-route 0 --reason "auto-pause" && rwdctl config unpin routing.fallback` plus graceful canary drain steps.
tori h: thanks team. will write a short incident summary tomorrow if we don't resume. CC @sre-oncall for overnight alerts. :eyes:
